newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police detain suspected Italian mobster.
newsitem.headline: German police detain suspected Italian mobster.

text.p: German police said on Tuesday they had detained a suspected Italian mobster in the southern town of Neu-Ulm after Italian authorities put in a request for his extradition.
The 36-year-old Sicilian, identified only as Pietro D., was suspected of belonging to the Italian Cosa Nostra crime organisation and of being a major drugs trafficker, police said.
He was arrested unarmed and without resistance in Neu-Ulm, a small town between Stuttgart and Munich where he was thought to have been living since late last year.
The suspect came from the Sicilian village of Adrano and was believed to be one of the last remaining members of the once-powerful Santapaolo clan, police said.
